import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem dyadic_prefix_product_ordered (r a b : ℕ) (hab : a ≤ b) :
  (∏ k ∈ Finset.range r,
      (a ^ (2 ^ k) + b ^ (2 ^ k))) * (b - a) =
    b ^ (2 ^ r) - a ^ (2 ^ r) := by
  induction r with
  | zero =>
      simp
  | succ r ih =>
      have hxy : a ^ (2 ^ r) ≤ b ^ (2 ^ r) := by
        gcongr
  
      have he : 2 ^ (Nat.succ r) = 2 ^ r + 2 ^ r := by
        simp [pow_succ, Nat.mul_two]
  
      have ha :
          a ^ (2 ^ Nat.succ r) =
            a ^ (2 ^ r) * a ^ (2 ^ r) := by
        rw [he, pow_add]
  
      have hb :
          b ^ (2 ^ Nat.succ r) =
            b ^ (2 ^ r) * b ^ (2 ^ r) := by
        rw [he, pow_add]
  
      calc
        (∏ k ∈ Finset.range (Nat.succ r),
            (a ^ (2 ^ k) + b ^ (2 ^ k))) * (b - a) =
            ((∏ k ∈ Finset.range r,
              (a ^ (2 ^ k) + b ^ (2 ^ k))) * (b - a)) *
              (a ^ (2 ^ r) + b ^ (2 ^ r)) := by
                rw [Finset.prod_range_succ]
                ring
        _ = (b ^ (2 ^ r) - a ^ (2 ^ r)) *
              (a ^ (2 ^ r) + b ^ (2 ^ r)) := by
                rw [ih]
        _ = b ^ (2 ^ Nat.succ r) - a ^ (2 ^ Nat.succ r) := by
                have hxx :
                    a ^ (2 ^ r) * a ^ (2 ^ r) ≤
                      b ^ (2 ^ r) * a ^ (2 ^ r) := by
                  gcongr
                have hyy :
                    a ^ (2 ^ r) * b ^ (2 ^ r) ≤
                      b ^ (2 ^ r) * b ^ (2 ^ r) := by
                  gcongr
                have hcross :
                    b ^ (2 ^ r) * a ^ (2 ^ r) =
                      a ^ (2 ^ r) * b ^ (2 ^ r) := by
                  ac_rfl
                rw [Nat.sub_mul, Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_add, ha, hb]
                rw [hcross]
                omega
